biggest_catch: Instant Pay is locked until you've done 5+ gigs over 7+ days — your first week of work can't be cashed out same-day.
catches: Instant Pay eligibility: first gig completed >7 days ago AND 5+ total gigs; 1-day security wait after adding a debit card.
Instant Pay costs $1.99 per cashout; weekly Wednesday-morning deposit is free.
Not every gig is worth it — payments are per gig based on distance/size/urgency; senders choose among driver proposals.
Tolls/parking reimbursements only start 15 days after the gig.
Cancelled gigs pay only a small cancellation fee (~$4 reported).

c1.evidence: Official Roadie driver blog (driver.roadie.com): 'Roadie's Instant Pay option lets drivers cash out instantly... tap the Cash Out Now button in Gig History to receive your payment immediately.'

c2.evidence: Official Roadie: every gig shows its guaranteed payout before you accept (third-party gig guides confirm 'Each proposal includes your guaranteed payout').

c3.evidence: No fee to sign up as a Roadie driver; Instant Pay fee is per-cashout, not upfront.

c4.evidence: Official Roadie: Instant Pay payment 'within minutes (depending on your bank)'; $1.99 processing fee. Same-day cashout confirmed once eligible.

eligibility: 18+; vehicle; driver's license; smartphone; auto insurance.

s3.note: Instant Pay payment within minutes once eligible — today.

steps: Download the Roadie app and complete the driver application.
Propose on gigs near you; each gig shows its guaranteed payout before you accept.
Pick up and complete the delivery.
After 7+ days and 5+ gigs, add a debit card to enable Instant Pay (1-day security wait).
Tap Cash Out Now in Gig History — payment lands within minutes, $1.99 fee. Otherwise weekly deposit Wednesday morning.
timing: Instant Pay once eligible (5+ gigs, 7+ days): cash out instantly, payment within minutes, $1.99 fee. Otherwise weekly direct deposit Wednesday morning.
who_pays: Roadie pays you per completed gig — each gig's payment is based on distance, size, and urgency, and is set when you propose on the gig.
who_qualifies: 18+; a vehicle; a driver's license; auto insurance; a smartphone.
work_available: Senders post gigs and choose among driver proposals — you compete on every gig, and not every gig is worth the drive. Availability depends on sender demand in your area.
what_gets_accepted: Complete the delivery. Cancelled gigs pay only a small cancellation fee (about $4 reported). Toll and parking reimbursements only start 15 days after the gig.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: proposals you don't win, waiting between gigs, and your vehicle costs. Instant Pay costs $1.99 per cashout.
when_cash_arrives: Instant Pay once eligible (5+ gigs over 7+ days): cash out instantly, paid within minutes ($1.99 fee). Otherwise, free weekly direct deposit on Wednesday mornings.

repeatable.cadence: New gigs post regularly — complete a gig, cash out instantly once eligible, and claim the next one.
